advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: The tier 4 rules are recommendations of Codex.
advisory.problem: Line 28 of skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md puts recommendations of Codex in tier 4, but the pointer target SKILL.md (line 7 points to it) defines tier 4 at line 68 as only the recommendations of the Agent Skills specification and the move rules of references/loading-rules.md, so the tier of these rules does not agree with the tier definition.
advisory.correction: "The tier 4 rules are recommendations of Codex. Use them with the tier of the recommendations of the Agent Skills specification." Alternatively, add "It also contains the recommendations of Codex for `agents/openai.yaml`." to tier 4 in "When two sources do not agree" in SKILL.md.
